english.title: Cause death by dangerous driving
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused the death of **(..SPECIFY NAME OF DECEASED AND DATE OF DEATH IF DIFFERENT FROM DATE OF DRIVING..) by driving a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), dangerously on a

(A)_[road]_
(B)_[public place]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD OR PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the death of a person
by dangerously driving a mechanically propelled vehicle
on a road/in a public place

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 2a of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for the meaning of dangerous driving.
(ii) See section 13a of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for disapplication of section 1 for authorised motoring events.
(iii) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(iv) CPS Advice - Make sure you know the C.P.S. guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges. When investigating these offences consideration must be given to the advice offered in the charging standards for causing death by dangerous driving.

other.penalty:
INDICTMENT ONLY: Ten years imprisonment.

Obligatory disqualification and endorsement - disqualification until test passed.

Licence endorsed three to eleven penalty points - only if special reasons apply.

The vehicle may be forfeited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
